job_id_hint: the hub picks it before starting, e.g. slot1-20261013-0900, and passes --job-id; "auto" = slot1-<date-time>
title: PeakPack for Mac - slot 1: preflight, Steam bridge, runtime, game files, modded launch, short perf run
requester: PeakPack for Mac (MacPort lead) - Joshua's project

machine.screen: ours for the whole slot (computer-use steps click in Steam and PEAK)
needs: Mac Steam running under fleet (signed in once with Remember me; the kit never reads Steam login/config files, G-B1's BLoggedOn proves the login)

Run INSIDE fleet's logged-in GUI (Aqua) session: the hub launches every PEAK slot from a LaunchAgent in gui/501 (verified 13 Oct: G-A1 passed in job slot1b-20261013-0439). `launchctl managername` must print Aqua; from a plain remote shell (Background) every gate that opens a Wine/Unity window ends BLOCKED (exit 2). The LaunchAgent context has no Screen Recording permission, so in-kit screenshots fail and are only logged (never a gate failure).
screen recording + input control for the hub's tooling (already granted)
optional: Xcode Command Line Tools: NOT required (CI ships d3d11_clear.exe and the macOS x86_64 steam_client_probe in the tests tarball; with the CLT, G-B0 uses the exact nm export check)

assets_not_needed: peakpack-steam-bridge-* (already merged into the runtime tarball)
release.verification: every asset is checked against the release's SHA256SUMS by the kit (lib/assets.sh)
release.also_downloaded: PeakPack.exe + PeakPack.exe.sha256 from https://github.com/jmproulx/peakpack/releases/latest/download/ (newest pack release, rev 5 or later; G-D2 verifies the SHA-256)

steam_tests.note: tests-only prerelease (CI mac-steam-tests.yml): T1-T4 probes with the PEAK-style auth-ticket call, d3d11_clear.exe, Mac gate scripts; overrides the runtime release's tests package; verified against its SHA256SUMS

peakpack.note: PeakPack.exe for G-D2 and G-A2-lite from this prerelease (verified against its SHA256SUMS; 0.4.3 verifies the mod list signature with a managed P-256 verifier under Wine). Remove to use releases/latest.

kit.kit_tag_note: kit-only git tag (no release); the runtime still comes from release.tag via --release
kit.standalone: a tarball of mac/testkit works the same (it then takes the Steam test scripts from the release asset)
kit.setup: JOB=~/peakpack-test/<job_id>; mkdir -p $JOB/kit && curl -fsSL <source_archive> | tar -xz -C $JOB/kit --strip-components=2 peakpack-mac-testkit-0.3.9/mac && cd $JOB/kit   (the kit then lives at $JOB/kit/testkit, next to $JOB/kit/runtime; cleanup.sh removes it with the job dir)
kit.invoke_as: bash testkit/<script>.sh (never rely on exec bits)

job_dir: ~/peakpack-test/<job_id>  (everything is written here; exceptions listed under outside_paths)

how_to_run.all_in_one: cd $JOB/kit && bash testkit/run_slot.sh testkit/slot1.job.json --job-id <job_id> > $JOB/run_slot-console.txt 2>&1 &   (background; watch requests with: bash testkit/cu.sh $JOB wait)
how_to_run.computer_use: scripts print [CU-REQUEST] lines and write <job-dir>/cu/<gate>.<step>.request; do the steps in gates/<gate>.md (section CU-<step>), then answer: bash testkit/cu.sh <job-dir> done <gate>.<step> ok|fail|skip "note" [key=value ...]

early_cu.instruction: Start this right after H-STEAM passes; it runs in Steam while the scripts do G-B0/G-B1/G-A1. In Mac Steam open the console (in Terminal: open steam://open/console, or Safari's address bar: steam://open/console and allow it to open Steam). Click the input line at the bottom of the Console view, type exactly: download_depot 3527290 3527291 and press Return. Screenshot evidence/G-B5/b5-console-started.png. When the console prints 'Depot download complete : "<path>" (manifest <id>)' (about 1.93 GB), screenshot b5-console-complete.png and answer: bash testkit/cu.sh <job-dir> done G-B5.download ok "complete" path="<path>" manifest=<id>. On an error line answer fail "<message>". Never type credentials; do not quit Steam.

gates.title: Preflight (detect and report)
gates.pass: arm64; Rosetta present; >= 12 GB free (20 recommended); github.com reachable; base tools present. CLT/Steam/screencapture are reported only.

gates.title: Mac Steam running (no login files read)
gates.needs_human: only if Steam is not running and a sign-in window appears when the hub opens it
gates.pass: steam_osx running (Steam.app installed; client bootstrapped). Signed-in is proven by G-B1, not here
gates.on_fail: exit 3: the hub may run `open -a Steam` (no credentials), wait ~30 s and re-run H-STEAM; only a sign-in window needs Joshua

gates.title: steamclient.dylib x86_64 slice + exports (T0)
gates.pass: x86_64 slice present; CreateInterface, Steam_BGetCallback, Steam_FreeLastCallback, Steam_GetAPICallResult, Steam_ReleaseThreadLocalMemory exported
gates.on_fail: continue; a missing x86_64 slice blocks Track B2 (report it prominently)

gates.title: Rosetta probe talks to Mac Steam (T1/T2)
gates.pass: dylib loads under Rosetta; CreateInterface(SteamClient021); BLoggedOn=1; real SteamID; app id 3527290; auth ticket + GetAuthSessionTicketResponse OK; Mac Steam shows Playing PEAK

gates.title: Runtime boots (download, verify, prefix, cmd/reg/regedit, D3D11 via DXMT)
gates.pass: assets match SHA256SUMS; wine --version; prefix created in the job dir with DXMT; cmd /c ver; PEAK.exe overrides; regedit export; d3d11_clear.exe (run as PEAK.exe) renders through DXMT: device ok, readback ok, native d3d11/dxgi + winemetal loaded

gates.title: PEAK Windows depot via download_depot (T15)
gates.pass: download_depot completes; PEAK.exe, UnityPlayer.dll, steam_api64.dll, Assembly-CSharp.dll, version.txt; >= 200 files, 1.5-3 GB; every file's SHA-256 equals the Windows reference when version.txt matches (2.6.b); moved into <job>/game/PEAK

gates.title: Steam bridge in Wine: T3, T4, T5 (PEAK main menu)
gates.pass: T3 SteamID+ticket via forwarder; T4 RestartAppIfNecessary=0, IsSteamRunning=1, InitEx OK, SteamID, app id, ticket; T5 Player.log 'Steam runtime manager initialized: True' with persona, no Steamworks.NET failures; main menu renders (agent)

gates.title: PeakPack modded + vanilla launch
gates.pass: PeakPack.exe matches PeakPack.exe.sha256; --status/--sync exit 0; modded launch: LogOutput.log rewritten, chainloader complete, every plugin in expect/pack-plugins.txt loaded (rev 5: 8 incl. PeakPack MacPreset), no BepInEx load errors, main menu (agent); vanilla: Steam initialised, LogOutput.log untouched, no BepInEx/Doorstop in Player.log

gates.title: Short performance run (Metal HUD, solo to the Shore, 2 min)
gates.pass: no crash; Shore 1 % low >= 30 fps from MacPreset's frame-time log (modded run; HUD readings every 30 s as cross-check / fallback); memory pressure never critical; swap growth < 1 GB. Recorded: avg fps, menu fps, RSS. (>= 90 % of CrossOver needs the optional G-A2-CX, skipped in slot 1)

human_steps.when: already done (hub reports Mac Steam signed in under fleet with Remember me)
human_steps.what: nothing else in slot 1; if H-STEAM ever exits 3 (signed out), the slot waits for Joshua (away ~17:00-21:30 MDT 12 Oct)

later_slots: slot3.job.json (G-X1, H-MIC; humans), slot4.job.json (G-C0 native smoke, optional G-A2-CX)

optional_human_gates.what: cross-play (Mac on Joshua's account; friend on their own Windows PC), voice, mic prompt

outside_paths: ~/Library/Application Support/Steam/[Steam.AppBundle/Steam/Contents/MacOS/]steamapps/content/app_3527290 (download_depot output; moved into the job dir by G-B5, empty folder removed)
~/Library/Application Support/Steam/[...]/depotcache/3527291_*.manifest (Steam writes it during the download; cleanup.sh removes new ones)
/tmp/.wine-<uid>/server-<dev>-<inode> (Wine server socket of our prefix; removed by cleanup.sh)
Steam-side records of playtime/'Playing PEAK' on Joshua's account (server-side, expected)
macOS-managed caches: Rosetta AOT translations (/var/db/oah), Metal shader caches (per-user temp) - system-managed, not removed

contains: logs/<gate>/ (console.log, Player.log copies, LogOutput.log, wine/DXMT logs, manifests)
copy_back.also_relay: the agent's own screenshots named in the CU steps if they were saved elsewhere, and the run_slot console output

removes: our Wine processes and anything started from the job dir
Steam depot content/download folders and depotcache files created by this job
the job dir including the kit ($JOB/kit)
leaves: anything that existed before the job

scheduling_note: Slot 1 needs no human: it can run unattended, including while Joshua is away. Human gates (G-X1, H-MIC) are in slot 3.
